captions.text: Contacts gives your department a shared directory of people,
organizations, and locations.
Keep member accounts and roster roles in Personnel; use this directory
for useful operational references.
In our fictional Chicago Fire training department, we are in
Contacts, on the Categories page.
The category table separates its name, description, color, and contact count.
It starts empty here, even though the department already
has uncategorized contacts.
We will create a small partner directory and verify each saved entry.
